currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful aerial/west-front photographs plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM; no bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: Elevated south view: two western pinnacled square towers, a taller plain flat-topped central crossing tower, long pale lead-gray nave/choir roofs, stepped side aisles and flying buttresses, gabled transept with large rose/lancets, and the separate northeast octagonal chapterhouse with steep pale pyramid. Lower south vestry/annexes join the church. Temporary east scaffolding is excluded from the intended exterior. Profile heights, pinnacles and detailed tracery require approximate interpretation.

West front: twin square towers with tall louvered pointed belfry panels, projecting corner/secondary pinnacles and parapets; large central pointed window with six lower lancets, triangular central gable, pointed twin-leaf entry beneath a taller arch and two smaller side doors/windows. Exact sculpture, stone tracery, inscriptions and historic cars/trees are excluded.
